- AC7 diff lists exactly the 5 claimed paths.
- AC8 `ruff check src tests docs` clean.
- AC9 `docs/release-notes.md` 17 additions, 0 deletions.
- AC10 `make verify` exit 0 — 19,837 passed, 90 skipped, 0:50:20.

**One advisory finding from `LLM-Review`, verified correct and being fixed under this ticket rather than deferred.** `tests/unit/test_prompt_front_matter.py:157` — the section header above the golden round-trip block — still read "the MIGRATED BUILT-IN prompts (the 6 reviewers)". The slice updated the sibling count at :174 but missed this one, so the slice itself is what made it wrong. Operational note for later slices: a `git merge-base --is-ancestor <pushed-sha> origin/main` mirror check can never succeed when Gerrit rebases. Read `current_revision` off the merged change and poll for *that* SHA instead — it appeared on the GitHub mirror about 1 minute after submit.

compiled_state.description:
Final slice of epic 87d8. Deletes the `ticket-quality` reviewer prompt, regenerates
the generated catalog index, and shrinks the two test rosters that enumerate packaged
prompts by name. After this slice the string `ticket-quality` survives only in the
three artifact classes this epic has excluded throughout.

## Ordering

Both predecessors have landed on `main`, so this slice is unblocked and its census
below is a plain reading of the current tree.

- Slice 8 (`d4ca-0470-d792-49df`, merged `f457acbefe1`) repointed seven test files
  that resolve `ticket-quality` out of the catalog onto `code-quality`. Deleting the
  prompt before that landed would have failed every one of them, because each looks
  the prompt up by id.
- Slice 9 (`9b96-18b7-b19e-4f85`, merged `ded208db10c`) repointed
  `tests/unit/workflow/test_review_skeleton.py` and the workflow example it covers
  onto `spec-alignment`. That dependency was a correctness one rather than a
  test-enforced one: the engine batches whatever prompt ids a step lists without
  consulting the catalog, so the shipped example would have silently named a deleted
  prompt rather than failing.

## Context

Epic 87d8 retires the single-pass review demo and its `ticket-quality` reviewer
prompt. Slices 1-9 removed every consumer: the engine, the workflow example, the
variant and override tests, the framework documentation, and the seven test files
that used the prompt as a stand-in for a real packaged reviewer. This slice removes
the prompt itself.

A census with `git grep -cF -e 'ticket-quality' -e 'ticket_quality' -- src tests`
on current `main` reports hits in exactly four paths, and those four are this slice's
subject:

- `src/rebar/llm/reviewers/ticket_quality.md` (57 lines) — the prompt.
- `src/rebar/llm/reviewers/index.json` — the generated catalog. The
  `"ticket-quality"` object spans lines 75-86 and is the last entry, so removing it
  deletes 12 lines and rewrites the preceding entry's closing brace. This file is
  generated and is never hand-edited; it is produced by
  `python -m rebar.llm.prompting.prompts regenerate-index`.
- `tests/unit/test_prompt_cache_split.py:32` — one element of `_MARKED_PROMPTS`, the
  tuple of prompts carrying the cache-split marker.
- `tests/unit/test_prompt_front_matter.py:183` — one element of the literal set in
  `test_built_in_prompts_are_discovered`, the guard against a vacuous parametrize.

That guard's comment above it reads "the 6 migrated reviewers must be present" and
becomes "the 5", so the comment still describes the set below it. The catalog drops
from 6 reviewers to 5: `code-quality`, `completion-verifier`, `security`,
`spec-alignment` and `tests`.

Three artifact classes stay out of scope, as in every prior slice:
`evals/plan-review-gate/runs/*.jsonl` (frozen corpora whose stored prompts must keep
describing the run that produced them), and the tracked `.test_durations` (a
pytest-split cache that ignores unknown node IDs and regenerates itself).
`docs/release-notes.md` is historical narrative, including this epic's own entries,
so its existing mentions stay; this slice only prepends a new entry to it.

## Change

Four files plus the release note. Delete `ticket_quality.md`. Regenerate `index.json`
with the packaged command rather than editing it. Remove the one `"ticket-quality",`
line from each of the two rosters, and correct the count in the adjacent comment.

Both rosters feed a `parametrize`, so the collected node-ID set shrinks by exactly
two:

- `tests/unit/test_prompt_cache_split.py::test_marked_prompt_prefix_is_variable_free[ticket-quality]`
- `tests/unit/test_prompt_front_matter.py::test_built_in_prompt_round_trips_canonically[ticket-quality-path85]`

No other node ID is renumbered. `_packaged_prompt_paths()` sorts by prompt id and
`ticket-quality` sorts last, so no surviving `pathNN` suffix shifts. The two files
collect 117 node IDs before and 115 after.

## Testing

No new tests. Deleting a prompt is proven by the existing suites that enumerate the
catalog: a missed consumer fails at resolution. The whole affected set was run with
slice 8's substitution and this slice's four changes applied together —
`test_prompt_cache_split.py`, `test_prompt_front_matter.py`, `test_prompt_index.py`,
`test_prompt_library_writes.py`, `test_prompts_git_canonical.py`,
`test_generated_surface_markers.py`, `tests/interfaces/store/test_agent_op_safeguard.py`,
`tests/interfaces/store/test_llm_framework.py` and `tests/unit/workflow/` — and
reported 937 passed, 9 skipped, with no failures.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] **AC1** `git grep -cF -e 'ticket-quality' -e 'ticket_quality' -- src tests
      scripts` prints nothing and exits 1. Before this slice it prints four paths.
- [x] **AC2** `test -e src/rebar/llm/reviewers/ticket_quality.md` exits 1.
- [x] **AC3** `python -m rebar.llm.prompting.prompts regenerate-index` exits 0 and
      leaves `git status --short src/rebar/llm/reviewers/index.json` empty, proving
      the committed index is exactly what the generator produces.
- [x] **AC4** `python -c "import json;print(len(json.load(open('src/rebar/llm/reviewers/index.json'))))"`
      prints `6`. Before this slice it prints `7`. The index is an object keyed
      by reviewer id plus one `_generated_by` metadata key, so the printed count
      is the reviewer count plus one: 5 reviewers after, 6 before.
- [x] **AC5** `pytest tests/unit/test_prompt_cache_split.py
      tests/unit/test_prompt_front_matter.py -q` exits 0 and its last line is
      `115 passed`. Before this slice it is `117 passed`.
- [x] **AC6** Collecting those two files with `pytest ... -q --collect-only`, keeping
      lines containing a double colon and sorting them, differs from the same
      collection on `origin/main` by exactly the two node IDs named in Change, both
      as deletions, with no other line changed.
- [x] **AC7** `git diff --numstat origin/main...HEAD` lists exactly
      `src/rebar/llm/reviewers/ticket_quality.md`,
      `src/rebar/llm/reviewers/index.json`, `tests/unit/test_prompt_cache_split.py`,
      `tests/unit/test_prompt_front_matter.py` and `docs/release-notes.md`, and no
      other path.
- [x] **AC8** `ruff check src tests docs` exits 0 with no output.
- [x] **AC9** `git diff --numstat origin/main...HEAD -- docs/release-notes.md` shows a
      non-zero addition count and `0` deletions.
- [x] **AC10** `make verify` exits 0.
